entries.text: [d3] Surgeons: Tall, dark-robed humanoids with a monastic aura and heads encased in black iron boxes. The creators of the grotesque art within the district. Armed with rusty tools and surgical items: scalpels, bonesaws, needles, cleavers, etc. 14 STR, 14 DEX, 10HP, Surgical Tools (d6), Spit Yellow Resin (DEX to avoid or movement is impaired – if not removed, hardens to a solid in d6 rounds, immobilizing the victim). When dealing Critical Damage, will harvest a body part. They are carrying [surgeon_table]. The Surgeons react to the group by [wagoneer_surgeon_reaction_table]

entries.text: A large plush doll lies discarded in the ditch. Once it may have been a purple bunny, now it looks more like an eel with limbs. It looks up at any passerby and demands: "Hey Bub, come gimme a hug." If the offer is declined, the Mockery will crawl away in self-pity. On embrace one will find the Mockery to be damp and much heavier than might have been anticipated. The Mockery will cling to whoever hugs it, and if the hug is broken, attack by biting.
